text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
The "Empress" herself, Hishi Amazon,
who put on a spectacular performance at the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "It is said that her running form calls to mind a brave and valiant warrior!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, no no, you're laying it on a bit thick there.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon-san,
could you share your enthusiasm for this race?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know full well it's a race
where absolute monsters gather.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But that's all the more reason—
I have to win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll surpass this and aim even higher!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That pre-race interview
got the audience in the stands wildly excited.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You're raring to go, Hishi Amazon!
You were amazing in the Osaka Hai, after all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Amazon"? (Joketsu)
That suits this girl perfectly, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen, bearing immense expectations, begins!
